shared_elements: engraved/carved relief on a rock surface
justification: A shows a large geometric, grid-like rectangular design with rows of short repeated strokes below it — essentially an abstract compartmented motif — while B shows naturalistic animals in profile (a quadruped in low relief with a smaller creature and a snake-like form below it) on the face of a pillar. The only real overlap is that both are carved on stone surfaces and B's animals could loosely echo the small vaguely zoomorphic marks in A; the dominant subject matter (abstract grid versus animal figures) is entirely different, as are the compositional relationships.
